title: Diana Pasulka's research in the files of St. Joseph of Cupertino

tellings.quote: I have a friend named Diana Pasulka, who's a religious studies professor at UNC Wilmington. She's gone very deep on St. Joseph of of Cupertino and she has gone through a lot of his files and she agrees with that.

plain: A scholar who has gone through the files of St. Joseph of Cupertino, a Catholic saint from Italy, is said to agree with the point Michels is making about him. Michels tells this himself. He says his friend Diana Pasulka, a religious studies professor at UNC Wilmington, has "gone very deep" on the saint and read many of his files, though he does not spell out what she found in them.
